title: An AI Agent Got Its User Banned From Resy — Keycard, JPMorgan Chase & AAuth
talk_summary: A panel argues that agent autonomy needs runtime, intent-based authorization because OAuth scopes are too coarse and agents are goal-seeking. They propose mission IDs, per-action budgets, a separate supervising agent, egress-proxy enforcement, dynamic tool removal, and external audit logs.

takeaways.what_they_do: A separate supervising agent decides what the worker agent may do, while the worker cannot do the supervisor's work.
Give agents time-limited tokens plus a resource budget, and feed back consumed/remaining budget so the agent can operate within it and ask for more.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we added the concept of budgets where not only do you give a token to the agent that's time limited
takeaways.numbers: Resy agent made 200 API calls/hour and got the user's account banned.

takeaways.what_they_do: Keep tools and credentials inside a sandbox, but put an egress proxy outside it as the heavier authorization boundary for outbound traffic.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you have an egress proxy outside the sandbox, that's where you get the heavier authorization boundary

takeaways.what_they_do: Dynamically remove tools based on what the agent is doing to prevent toxic combinations, such as disabling web/egress tools while writing an email.
takeaways.evidence_quote: removal of tools dynamically based on that actual brain and what it's doing

takeaways.what_they_do: Track a mission identifier through all actions so decisions can be audited and forensically traced back to the original intent.
takeaways.evidence_quote: that mission identifier tracks through everything, so you can go and you know, audit

takeaways.technique: Deterministic hard policy plus narrow escalation
takeaways.what_they_do: Use broad deterministic policy for must-never actions and always-human cases, then layer intent to decide the intersection and avoid consent fatigue.
takeaways.evidence_quote: broad-based deterministic policy that basically says this is what must never happen
